messages:
Marta - Procurement: FYI EmbedLabs sent renewal + an unexpected invoice line for 'ingestion fees'. Can someone triage cost impact? Link: https://drive.google.com/embedlabs. @Alex @Sanjay @Priya

Alex (Finance): Paste the invoice line please. We need amount, period, and meter definition.

Marta - Procurement: Invoice excerpt: 
```
Line: Ingestion processing fee
Amount: $6,250
Period: Apr 2026
Notes: applies to high-dim batch imports (>5M vectors)
```

Sanjay (ML Eng): We did a one-time migration in Apr of ~6.2M vectors @1536d. Curious how they calculated this fee. Our normal embedding traffic is separate.

EmbedLabs Rep: Hi team 44b Sorry for surprise. Ingestion fee applies to large one-off bulk imports that require cluster warm-up and special ETL. We typically waive for renewals >=12 months or if a hybrid reserved pool is purchased.

Alex (Finance): If they waive with renewal, what's the delta vs our current quote? Also need a sample invoice mapping reserved vs usage vs one-time fees.

EmbedLabs Rep: Proposed options: (A) Renew committed plan: 4 seats + 200M included @ $6,800/mo, waive ingestion fee and give 10% discount on overage. (B) Pure usage: $0.000021/embed, ingestion fee remains. (C) Hybrid: 2 seats + 100M included + usage overlay @ $0.000013/embed and ingestion fee waived once. All 12-month terms.

Ting Li (Platform): Engineering asks: are included units pooled org-wide? Does ingestion fee depend on vector dim or total compute time? Need metering spec.

EmbedLabs Rep: Included units are org-pooled. Ingestion fee is priced by billable compute minutes for batch ETL; higher dims increase compute minutes. We can provide a billable minutes breakdown for the April job.

Priya (Legal): We'll need ingestion fee language in contract (one-time fees, disputes, evidence). Also request a 60-day wind-down and data export clause.

Alex (Finance): Preferred ask: get hybrid (option C) and request a sample peak-month invoice, annual price cap (max 5%) and credits for SLA breaches. Procurement to ask vendor to confirm.

Marta - Procurement: OK I'll request formal revised quote with sample invoice, the ingestion fee breakdown, metering spec, and SLA appendix. @Procurement-Bot create PR when docs arrive.

Procurement-Bot: Created PR #508: "EmbedLabs renewal & ingestion fee review". Approvers: Alex (Finance), Priya (Legal), Security. Link: https://procurement.internal/pr/508

Marta - Procurement: Thanks. Will post rev quote when received and schedule a 15-min triage. :thumbsup:
